source_text: [1] Μηδεὶς πλανάσθω: καὶ τὰ ἐπουράνια καὶ ἡ δόξα τῶν ἀγγέλων καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ὁρατοί τε καὶ ἀόρατοι, ἐὰν μὴ πιστεύσωσιν εἰς τὸ αἷμα Χριστοῦ, κἀκείνοις κρίσις ἐστίν: ὁ χωρῶν χωρείτω. τόπος μηδένα φυσιούτω: τὸ γὰρ ὅλον ἐστὶν πίστις καὶ ἀγάπη, ὧν οὐδὲν προκέκριται. [2] καταμάθετε δὲ τοὺς ἑτεροδοξοῦντας εἰς τὴν χάριν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τὴν εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐλθοῦσαν, πῶς ἐναντίοι εἰσὶν τῇ γνώμῃ τοῦ θεοῦ. περὶ ἀγάπης οὐ μέλει αὐτοῖς, οὐ περὶ χήρας, οὐ περὶ ὀρφανοῦ, οὐ περὶ θλιβομένου, οὐ περὶ δεδεμένου ἢ λελυμένου, οὐ περὶ πεινῶντος ἢ διψῶντος.
pass_a_gloss: [1] Let no one be deceived. Even the heavenly beings and the glory of the angels and the rulers, both visible and invisible, if they do not believe in the blood of Christ, for them too there is judgment. Let the one who can make room for it make room for it. Let position puff no one up; for the whole thing is faith and love, and nothing is preferred before them. [2] But take note of those who hold different opinions about the grace of Jesus Christ that came to us, how opposed they are to the mind of God. They have no concern for love, none for the widow, none for the orphan, none for the oppressed, none for the one in chains or the one set free, none for the hungry or thirsty.
pass_b_english: Let no one be deceived. Even the beings of heaven, the glory of the angels, and the rulers seen and unseen (Colossians 1:16), if they do not believe in the blood of Christ, face judgment too. Let anyone who can accept this accept it (Matthew 19:12). Let no one be puffed up by rank. Faith and love are everything. Nothing is preferred to them.

Take note of those who hold other opinions about the grace of Jesus Christ that has come to us, and see how opposed they are to the mind of God. They have no concern for love. They do not care for the widow or the orphan or the oppressed, for the prisoner or the freed, for the hungry or the thirsty.

choices.english: Let no one be puffed up by rank
choices.why: τόπος here is position or office in the church, not physical place.
rejected: let not place puff anyone up (opaque)

choices.term: τὸ γὰρ ὅλον ἐστὶν πίστις καὶ ἀγάπη
rejected: that which is worth all (ANF; adds 'worth')

choices.why: 'Hold other opinions' is the verb's sense; avoids the later technical 'heterodox' and does not add 'teach'.
Paired participles kept as a pair.

anf_compare.notes: Same sense. ANF's 'that which is worth all' and 'the glorious angels' are freer; this draft follows the Greek more closely.

bible_refs.note: 'Let the one who is able to receive it, receive it' - same verb chorein.
'visible and invisible ... rulers' echoes Paul's list of created powers; allusion, not quotation.

review.notes: Paragraph [1] checked clause by clause. Μηδεὶς πλανάσθω matches both 'Let no one be deceived'. καὶ τὰ ἐπουράνια καὶ ἡ δόξα τῶν ἀγγέλων καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ὁρατοί τε καὶ ἀόρατοι, ἐὰν μὴ πιστεύσωσιν εἰς τὸ αἷμα Χριστοῦ, κἀκείνοις κρίσις ἐστίν is kept in A ('if they do not believe in the blood of Christ, for them too there is judgment') and B ('if they do not believe in the blood of Christ, face judgment too'), with visible/invisible still modifying the rulers. ὁ χωρῶν χωρείτω, τόπος μηδένα φυσιούτω, τὸ γὰρ ὅλον ἐστὶν πίστις καὶ ἀγάπη, ὧν οὐδὲν προκέκριται match A's room/position clauses and B's 'Let no one be puffed up by rank. Faith and love are everything. Nothing is preferred to them.' Section 2 καταμάθετε δὲ τοὺς ἑτεροδοξοῦντας...πῶς ἐναντίοι εἰσὶν τῇ γνώμῃ τοῦ θεοῦ and the οὐ μέλει series (ἀγάπης, χήρας, ὀρφανοῦ, θλιβομένου, δεδεμένου ἢ λελυμένου, πεινῶντος ἢ διψῶντος) are complete in both, with negation and their agency intact. Title names the ὅλον thought. Added (Colossians 1:16) and (Matthew 19:12) are marked allusions, not false verses on the supplied wording.
